d:
Bihar ki rajniti men netaon aur sandigdh charitr vale logon ki vayral tasviron ko lekar chhire siyasi sangram ke bich bhajpa neta mrityunjay tivari ne rashtriy janta dal (RJD) par behad tikha hamla bola hai.
RJD ke naitik adhikar par dage saval:
Mrityunjay tivari ne aarjedi ke savalon ka javab dete hue kaha- 'aarjedi kya saval khare karegi? kya unke pas saval uthane ka koee naitik bal bacha hai? tejasvi yadav ki tasviren kitne maphiyaon, apradhiyon aur balatkariyon ke sath hain, yah pura bihar janta hai. jo khud kataghre men khare hain, ve dusron par kya saval uthaenge?'
